1.web: Oh clap your hands, all you nations. Shout to God with the voice of triumph!
1.asv: Oh clap your hands, all ye peoples; Shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

2.web: For Yahweh Most High is awesome. He is a great King over all the earth.
2.asv: For Jehovah Most High is terrible; He is a great King over all the earth.

3.web: He subdues nations under us, and peoples under our feet.
3.asv: He subdueth peoples under us, And nations under our feet.

4.web: He chooses our inheritance for us, the glory of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.
4.asv: He chooseth our inheritance for us, The glory of Jacob whom he loved. [Selah

5.web: God has gone up with a shout, Yahweh with the sound of a trumpet.
5.asv: God is gone up with a shout, Jehovah with the sound of a trumpet.

6.web: Sing praise to God, sing praises. Sing praises to our King, sing praises.
6.asv: Sing praises to God, sing praises: Sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

7.web: For God is the King of all the earth. Sing praises with understanding.
7.asv: For God is the King of all the earth: Sing ye praises with understanding.

8.web: God reigns over the nations. God sits on his holy throne.
8.asv: God reigneth over the nations: God sitteth upon his holy throne.

9.web: The princes of the peoples are gathered together, the people of the God of Abraham. For the shields of the earth belong to God. He is greatly exalted!
9.asv: The princes of the peoples are gathered together To bethe people of the God of Abraham; For the shields of the earth belong unto God: He is greatly exalted.
